articles.title: ECB officials are ready to raise interest rates in December
articles.expand: ECB officials are prepared to raise interest rates in December if the inflation outlook does not improve, according to people familiar with the discussions. Given current data and the economic fallout from the Middle East war, another 25bps hike will likely be needed to curb price pressures, the people said. They stressed that no decision has been made and the outlook could change quickly, particularly given the unpredictable nature of developments in the Middle East.
